name: IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCT_CHANGE_HIST
description: This table contains the history of external bank account verification and other related updates.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCT_CHANGE_HIST_ID
columns.description: Change history identifier for the external bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the source of EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_BANKACCT_ENTITY_TYPE.

columns.name: PREV_BANK_ACCT_CHANGE_HIST_ID
columns.description: Last change request identifier.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: External bank account identifier.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_VERIF_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Bank account verification status. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_BANKACCT_VERIF_STATUS.

columns.name: PROVIDER_VERIF_RESPONSE_CODE
columns.description: Bank account verification response code retuned by the validation service provider.

columns.name: PROVIDER_VERIF_RESPONSE_MSG
columns.description: Bank account verification response message retuned by the validation service provider.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACCT_VERIF_RESP_CODE
columns.description: Internal translatable response code. Value are from lookup ORA_IBY_INTRNL_BA_VERIF_RESP.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_REQ_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Reference identifier for the request shared with the validation service provider.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code of the bank account.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the bank account.

columns.name: BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Bank branch identifier for the bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ID
columns.description: Bank identifier associated with the bank branch.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Complete external bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH1
columns.description: Hash of the external bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH2
columns.description: Hash of the salted bank account number.

columns.name: MASKED_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Masked bank account number used for display.

columns.name: BA_MASK_SETTING
columns.description: Current bank account masking setting. Values are from lookup IBY_INSTRUMENT_MASK_SETTING.

columns.name: BA_UNMASK_LENGTH
columns.description: Count of visible digits in the masked external bank account number.

columns.name: IBAN
columns.description: International bank account number.

columns.name: IBAN_HASH1
columns.description: Hash of the international bank account number.

columns.name: IBAN_HASH2
columns.description: Hash of the salted international bank account number.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account identifier for the validation service provider.

columns.name: MASKED_IBAN
columns.description: Masked international bank account number used for display.

columns.name: CHECK_DIGITS
columns.description: Check digits. Used in bank account format for error detection.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Bank account type. Values are from lookup IBY_BANKACCT_TYPES.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Bank account classification code.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SUFFIX
columns.description: Bank account suffix used to represent the account type.

columns.name: AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the agency location.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FACTOR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this is a payment factor bank account.

columns.name: FOREIGN_PAYMENT_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this bank account can be used for foreign payments. If the value is N, it'd be automatically implied that this account is for domestic payments.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_AGREEMENT_NUM
columns.description: Exchange rate agreement number.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the exchange rate agreement.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Represents the rate of exchange.

columns.name: HEDGING_CONTRACT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Reference code for the hedging contract.

columns.name: SECONDARY_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Account number reference such as the building society roll number.

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment instrument is encrypted.

columns.name: BA_NUM_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Bank account number security identifier.

columns.name: IBAN_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Security identifier for the international bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name assigned to the external bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternate name assigned to the bank account.

columns.name: SHORT_ACCT_NAME
columns.description: Short name assigned to the bank account.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description associated with the bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_ELECTRONIC
columns.description: Bank account number used in electronic files, if different from the written form.

columns.name: BA_NUM_ELEC_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Electronically-formatted bank number security segment identifier.

columns.name: SALT_VERSION
columns.description: Algorithm version used for encrypting the bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_PARTY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this bank account is associated with any bank and branch created in Trading Community Architecture (TCA). If the value is Yes or Null, then the bank and branch information is stored in TCA and the corresponding PARTY_IDs are stored in BANK_ID and BRANCH_ID columns. If the value is No, then the bank and branch information is stored directly in the columns BANK_NAME, BANK_NUMBER, BANK_BRANCH_NAME, BRANCH_NUMBER, and EFT_SWIFT_CODE.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of bank where payee has a bank account.

columns.name: BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Code or identifier issued to bank by banking regulatory authority.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank branch where payee has bank account.

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank branch number. This is known as routing transit number in US and Canada.

columns.name: EFT_SWIFT_CODE
columns.description: SWIFT code for bank or bank branch.

columns.name: VAT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Local currency VAT account to which the VAT amount is paid for foreign currency invoices.

columns.name: ORIGIN_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application used to create or update the bank account record.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Program or UI from which this row is created. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date of bank account activation.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date of bank account deactivation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
